facts.text: The Islander Guarantee covers tuition and mandatory fees for 15 credit hours for newly enrolled freshman Texas residents whose family adjusted gross income is $125,000 or less.

sources.title: Islander Guarantee | Funding Resources | Financial Aid | Cost & Aid | Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi
sources.quote: Resources have been dedicated to cover tuition and mandatory fees for 15 credit hours for newly enrolled freshman, Texas resident students whose Family Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) is $125,000 or less and meet other criteria.
